sentences.en: Are you going to let this fried chicken go begging?
sentences.zh: 你会让这份炸鸡浪费掉吗？

sentences.en: People will fry to a crisp in the sun today.
sentences.zh: 今天人们在太阳下会被晒得皮焦肉烂。

sentences.en: He fell out of the frying pan into the fire.
sentences.zh: 他从油锅里掉了出来，结果还是进了火堆。
